hook: A parent-built app now lists real costs at *451* Hyderabad schools
hook_b: A parent-built app now lists real costs at *451* Hyderabad schools
tldr: FirstBell, built by a Hyderabad parent, lets families compare full school costs, including transport, books, uniforms and yearly hikes.

beats.what: As of Nov 23 it listed 451 schools across 125 areas of Hyderabad and Secunderabad, with 98 anonymous parent submissions published.
beats.why: Schools quote tuition at admission but transport, books, uniforms and annual hikes are often not disclosed upfront.
beats.care: One parent said fees rise around 10% a year: ₹2 lakh can become ₹2.2 lakh the next year.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: It also collects commute times, homework load, teacher changes, CCTV and washroom cleanliness, submitted without names or phone numbers.

cards.q: Did your school disclose all fees upfront?

qs: Should schools be required to publish the full yearly cost?
How much of a school bill is not tuition?

facts.t: Published reviews cover *63 schools* in 34 areas so far.

viz.l: Fee hike example a parent gave
viz.verdict: Around 10% yearly hikes add up for parents paying
98 of 105 submissions are live, covering 63 schools in 34 areas

watch: Most responses so far are from west and north-west Hyderabad; coverage elsewhere is still thin.
